root: ^Tonight, a woman boarded the train. Young, at first glance, yet her eyes held something... ancient. I felt that this train had been waiting for her all along This train carries more than passengers.
^Good evening, Miss Bloodrose. Your ticket, please.
^Here it is. Station Maplewood, one-way ticket. No return.
^Understood. And may I ask the purpose of your journey?
^I am bound for a meeting… though, in truth, it comes many years too late.
^Very well, Miss Bloodrose. Have a safe trip (stamp the ticket)
^I'm sorry Miss, I cannot let you pass (refuse)

accept: ^Thank you, kind man. I hope everything goes well for you.
refuse: ^Charlotte didn’t reached the designated destination, despite having a valid ticket
^I did not let her continue. Perhaps that is why I am here, to decide who arrives in time, and who remains behind.
^Charlotte didn’t reached the designated destination, despite having a valid ticket.
^The protocols. Please leave at the nearest station.
